title: Tracecat 1.0.0-beta.52-rc.12
body_markdown:
## Case management


- feat(cases): Add agent session interaction model ([#3315](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3315) )
- feat(agents): Propagate agent session provenance ([#3319](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3319) )
- feat(cases): Run workflows from comments with a slash command ([#3305](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3305) )
- feat(cases): Link table rows from the case page ([#3307](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3307) )
- fix(cases): Cap linked rows per table and paginate the case grids ([#3309](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3309) )
- feat(cases): Add version history restore flow ([#3301](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3301) )


## Agents


- feat(agents): Configurable timeouts ([#3050](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3050) )
- fix(agents): Grant required session execution scopes ([#3308](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3308) )


## Tracecat MCP


- feat(integrations): Retire broken MCP catalog stdio recipes ([#3312](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3312) )
- fix(ui): Polish MCP catalog badges, logos, and empty state ([#3318](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3318) )


## Integrations


- perf(integrations): Avoid reloading registry templates ([#3321](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3321) )
- feat(integrations): Revamp Google integrations with multi-source auth ([#3310](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3310) )
- feat(integrations): Add a user OAuth grant to google_admin ([#3314](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3314) )
- fix(ui): Add delete action for custom OAuth providers ([#3320](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3320) )
- feat(integrations): Add the Google SecOps remote MCP catalog row ([#3323](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3323) )
- feat(integrations): Add Google Chronicle actions ([#3322](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3322) )


## Engine


- feat(engine): Define versioned error envelope ([#3267](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3267) )


## User interface


- feat(ui): Move custom registry management into org settings ([#3304](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3304) )


## Documentation


- docs: Expression reference, cheatsheets, and navigation reorg ([#3296](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3296) )
- docs: Manage platform pages, agent timeouts, and org enrollment ([#3298](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3298) )
- docs: Split EE RBAC pages, make user management UI-driven ([#3300](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3300) )
- docs(enterprise): Clarify Enterprise license requirement ([#3311](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3311) )
- docs: Clarify secret environment use cases ([#3317](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3317) )


**Full changelog** :[1.0.0-beta.52-rc.11...1.0.0-beta.52-rc.12](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/compare/1.0.0-beta.52-rc.11...1.0.0-beta.52-rc.12)
